title: Pasture Soil-Moisture and Grazing Readiness
dataSources: Beehive telemetry (`beehive:reading`), coop door (`chickencoop:door`), egg counts (`egg:count`), livestock tags (`livestock:tag`), feed level (`feed:level`), pasture sensors (`pasture:sensor`).
app: Homestead sensors — connected beehive scale/temperature/sound, automatic chicken-coop door, egg counter, livestock GPS/health tags, feed-silo level, and pasture soil sensors — streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and LoRaWAN gateways.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=pasture:sensor
| stats avg(soil_moisture_pct) as moisture, avg(soil_temp_c) as temp by paddock
| eval growing=if(moisture>25 AND temp>8,"growing","resting")
| sort - moisture
description: Tracks soil moisture and temperature across paddocks to judge which are growing grass and ready to graze.
value: Rotational grazing depends on grass recovery; measuring paddock conditions helps move stock at the right time for healthy pasture.
implementation: Ingest pasture soil sensors into `index=personal`; review moisture and temperature by paddock.
visualization: Bar chart of soil moisture by paddock with a growing indicator.
grandmaExplanation: It checks how moist and warm the soil is in each field, so you know which are ready for animals to graze.
